A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GUIDE research work, with complete, readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–H. The material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original GUIDE-7B evaluations on ICLR 2025 submissions, including baseline comparisons, ablations, confidence analysis, and supplementary experiments in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains the original GUIDE-7B evaluations, numerical comparisons, ablations, and supplementary experimental results reported in v1.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same contribution extraction, modular summarization, retrieval, rubric-guided advising, and rating classifier. The Qwen2.5-7B warm-up and RAFT training procedure, including its reward objectives, are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ICLR 2016–2024 corpus, ICLR 2025 evaluation data, and alternative arXiv cs.LG retrieval corpus in Appendix C.1. No task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: GPT-4o-mini, QwQ-32B, and DeepSeek-R1 remain the main baselines. Gemini-flash-2.0 in the rubric tests, the AI Scientist variants and human reference in Table 6, and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in Table 11 retain their respective comparison roles.

E3.justification: The 1,000-paper ICLR 2025 test sample, ranking metrics, retrieval controls, decoding settings, and Appendix E training configurations are unchanged. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: Both retain the same retrieval-content and rubric ablations, confidence analysis, and Appendix B–C case studies. The retrieval-corpus shift, summarization-loss, and rating-distribution analyses are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 2 retains the same three-trial reporting and accompanying ± values. Run information, uncertainty reporting, and the rating-distribution statistics in Appendix C.3 are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, generated evaluation examples, and plotted results match across versions. For example, GUIDE-7B's Top-30% Precision remains 51.3 ± 0.4% in Table 2 and 52.3% under the arXiv retrieval setting in Table 11.

T1.justification: The problem definition, rating-distribution construction and smoothing, reward equations, and Shannon entropy definition are unchanged. No mathematical argument, assumption, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same claims about compact-model advising, modular summarization, rubric-guided alignment, and high-confidence acceptance prediction.

C2.justification: Interpretations of rubric effects, summarization, confidence, and optimism bias are unchanged. Both retain the machine-learning domain limitation, the qualification that the human comparison is only a rough reference, and Appendix F's misuse discussion.

D1.justification: The prompts, output schema, hardware, hyperparameters, training iterations, and annotation disclosure remain identical. The stated code access, actual code-link target, and scoring-system release conditions are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the positioning comparison in Table 1, and the reference list are unchanged. No cited work or substantive relationship to prior research is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 adds Yuxing Liu and Jiaxuan You to the author list, changes 'BingXu Meng' to 'Bingxu Meng', expands the email list, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded author list wraps onto two lines, with corresponding adjustments to the first-page contact block. Figures 1–7, Tables 1–16, their captions and placement, and the main-text and appendix layouts are otherwise retained.

improvement.justification: v2 updates authorship, contact information, and version presentation while preserving the scientific argument, empirical evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information throughout the main text and appendices. These changes establish no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
